message.content:
**Snowflake Inc. (CIK 1640147) — profitability trend, fiscal years ended January 31, 2019–2025**

Snowflake remained loss-making on a GAAP basis throughout every annual period in the database, but the trajectory is two-phased: steady margin improvement from FY2019 through FY2024, then a renewed deterioration in FY2025.

**Net loss and net margin (net loss attributable to Snowflake Inc. ÷ total revenue)**

| Fiscal year (end) | Revenue | Net loss attributable to Snowflake | Net margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| FY2019 (2019-01-31) | $96.7M | $(178.0)M | −184.2% |
| FY2020 (2020-01-31) | $264.7M | $(348.5)M | −131.6% |
| FY2021 (2021-01-31) | $592.0M | $(539.1)M | −91.1% |
| FY2022 (2022-01-31) | $1,219.3M | $(679.9)M | −55.8% |
| FY2023 (2023-01-31) | $2,065.7M | $(796.7)M | −38.6% |
| FY2024 (2024-01-31) | $2,806.5M | $(836.1)M | −29.8% |
| FY2025 (2025-01-31) | $3,626.4M | $(1,285.6)M | −35.5% |

Net margin improved by roughly 154 percentage points from FY2019 to FY2024 (loss narrowing from −184% to −30%), then worsened by about 5.7 points in FY2025. In absolute dollars the net loss widened every year, from $178.0M to $1,285.6M, because revenue growth outpaced the improvement in loss rate until FY2024.

**Operating loss** followed the same pattern: $(185.5)M (FY2019), $(358.1)M, $(543.9)M, $(715.0)M, $(842.3)M, $(1,094.8)M (FY2024), and $(1,456.0)M (FY2025). Operating margin was −40.2% in FY2025 versus −39.0% in FY2024 — a modest deterioration, so the FY2025 net-margin decline was amplified by non-operating items (other expense, net, of $(35.3)M in FY2025 versus +$44.9M income in FY2024) and a small tax provision.

**Gross margin** stayed high but slipped slightly: 66.5% in FY2025 versus 68.0% in FY2024 (gross profit $2,411.7M on $3,626.4M revenue, versus $1,907.9M on $2,806.5M). The FY2025 report's selected financial data shows operating expenses rising faster than revenue — total opex $3,867.7M versus $3,002.7M, with R&D up 38% to $1,783.4M — which explains the widening operating loss (10-K for FY ended 2025-01-31, chunk 1640147/snow-20250131:288000).

**Sources and definitions.** Figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001640147-25-000052, filed 2025-03-21): revenue fact IDs 2509712, 2509703, 2509691, 2509678, 2509665, 2509655, 2509651; net loss attributable to Snowflake IDs 2507831, 2507822, 2507810, 2507797, 2507784, 2507774, 2507770; operating loss IDs 2508026, 2508017, 2508005, 2507992, 2507979, 2507969, 2507965; gross profit IDs 2506762, 2506753, 2506741, 2506728, 2506715, 2506705, 2506701. Margins are my calculations from those reported values, not disclosed ratios. Note that the database's "NetIncomeLoss" tag equals net loss attributable to Snowflake Inc. (it excludes the small noncontrolling-interest portion, e.g. $1,289.2M consolidated net loss vs. $1,285.6M attributable in FY2025). All periods are full fiscal years ending January 31; no quarterly figures are used.
